name: tsh-stack-serverless
description: TSH practices for AWS Lambda services on OSLS: which libraries we use and which we avoid, how a serverless project is structured, TypeScript and bundler configuration for a Lambda runtime, handler implementation with middleware, event validation and structured logging, and the service definition itself — least-privilege IAM, reserved concurrency, secrets resolved at runtime, Step Functions task rules, and checks over the packaged CloudFormation template. No bootstrap and no example project: the practices are what make a service come out TSH-shaped.
